date: "2026-08-07"

############################################################
# 02_DEG_analysis.R
#
# Purpose:
#   Perform differential gene-expression analysis using
#   edgeR on the filtered DGEList generated in 01_data_QC.R.
#
# Main steps:
#   1. Load filtered edgeR object
#   2. Check experimental-condition metadata
#   3. Define the comparison
#   4. Construct the design matrix
#   5. Estimate dispersion
#   6. Fit negative-binomial GLM
#   7. Perform likelihood-ratio test
#   8. Apply user-defined DEG thresholds
#   9. Save complete and filtered DEG results
#  10. Summarize up- and downregulated genes
############################################################



# ==========================================================
# 1. USER SETTINGS
# ==========================================================

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# Project directory
# ----------------------------------------------------------

# CHANGE THIS to the main directory of your own project.
project_dir <- "YOUR/PROJECT/DIRECTORY/HERE"


# ----------------------------------------------------------
# Input file
# ----------------------------------------------------------

# Filtered + TMM-normalized edgeR object produced by
# 01_data_QC.R
dge_file <- "dge_fil.rds"


# ----------------------------------------------------------
# Experimental-condition column
# ----------------------------------------------------------

# Name of the column in dge_fil$samples containing the
# experimental groups.
condition_column <- "Condition"


# ----------------------------------------------------------
# DEFINE THE COMPARISON
# ----------------------------------------------------------

# Choose the groups to compare.
#
# The resulting log2 fold change will be:
#
#   comparison_group - reference_group
#
# Example:
#
#   comparison_group = "ES"
#   reference_group  = "CTL"
#
# gives:
#
#   ES - CTL
#
# Therefore:
#   positive logFC = higher in ES
#   negative logFC = higher in CTL

reference_group  <- "CTL"
comparison_group <- "ES"


# Name used in saved output files.
# You can change this if desired.
comparison_name <- paste0(
  comparison_group,
  "_vs_",
  reference_group
)


# ----------------------------------------------------------
# DEG CUTOFFS
# ----------------------------------------------------------

# Choose the thresholds that define a DEG.
#
# IMPORTANT:
# edgeR performs the statistical test for ALL genes first.
# These thresholds are applied afterwards to define the
# subset considered differentially expressed.


# ---- OPTION 1: original stringent cutoff ----
# logFC_cutoff <- 1
# FDR_cutoff   <- 0.05


# ---- OPTION 2: smaller effect-size cutoff ----
logFC_cutoff <- 0.1
FDR_cutoff   <- 0.05


# ---- OPTION 3: exploratory FDR threshold ----
# logFC_cutoff <- 0
# FDR_cutoff   <- 0.10


# NOTE:
# Only ONE pair of cutoff settings should be active.


# ----------------------------------------------------------
# Multiple-testing correction
# ----------------------------------------------------------

p_adjust_method <- "BH"


# ----------------------------------------------------------
# Sorting of complete DEG table
# ----------------------------------------------------------

# Options accepted by edgeR::topTags() include:
#   "PValue"
#   "logFC"
#   "none"
#
# "PValue" is generally easiest for inspecting top results.
sort_results_by <- "PValue"



# ==========================================================
# 2. LOAD PACKAGES
# ==========================================================

library(edgeR)



# ==========================================================
# 3. CHECK PROJECT DIRECTORY AND INPUT FILE
# ==========================================================

if (!dir.exists(project_dir)) {

  stop(
    paste0(
      "Project directory does not exist:\n",
      project_dir,
      "\n\nPlease update 'project_dir' in USER SETTINGS."
    )
  )
}


dge_path <- file.path(
  project_dir,
  dge_file
)


if (!file.exists(dge_path)) {

  stop(
    paste0(
      "Filtered DGE object not found:\n",
      dge_path,
      "\n\nRun the QC script first or check 'dge_file'."
    )
  )
}



# ==========================================================
# 4. CHECK CUTOFF SETTINGS
# ==========================================================

if (!is.numeric(logFC_cutoff) ||
    length(logFC_cutoff) != 1 ||
    is.na(logFC_cutoff) ||
    logFC_cutoff < 0) {

  stop(
    "logFC_cutoff must be one non-negative numeric value."
  )
}


if (!is.numeric(FDR_cutoff) ||
    length(FDR_cutoff) != 1 ||
    is.na(FDR_cutoff) ||
    FDR_cutoff <= 0 ||
    FDR_cutoff > 1) {

  stop(
    "FDR_cutoff must be a numeric value >0 and <=1."
  )
}



# ==========================================================
# 5. CREATE OUTPUT FOLDERS
# ==========================================================

# Generate a descriptive cutoff label automatically.
cutoff_label <- paste0(
  "FDR_",
  format(FDR_cutoff, trim = TRUE, scientific = FALSE),
  "_absLog2FC_",
  format(logFC_cutoff, trim = TRUE, scientific = FALSE)
)


deg_root_dir <- file.path(
  project_dir,
  "Results",
  "DGEA"
)


deg_list_dir <- file.path(
  deg_root_dir,
  "DEG_lists",
  cutoff_label
)


dir.create(
  deg_list_dir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)


message(
  "Results will be saved to:\n",
  deg_list_dir
)



# ==========================================================
# 6. LOAD FILTERED edgeR OBJECT
# ==========================================================

dge_fil <- readRDS(
  dge_path
)


if (!inherits(dge_fil, "DGEList")) {

  stop(
    "The loaded object is not an edgeR DGEList."
  )
}


message(
  "Filtered DGE object loaded."
)

message(
  "Genes available for differential-expression testing: ",
  nrow(dge_fil)
)

message(
  "Samples: ",
  ncol(dge_fil)
)



# ==========================================================
# 7. CHECK CONDITION METADATA
# ==========================================================

if (!(condition_column %in% colnames(dge_fil$samples))) {

  stop(
    paste0(
      "Condition column '",
      condition_column,
      "' was not found in dge_fil$samples.\n\n",
      "Available columns:\n",
      paste(
        colnames(dge_fil$samples),
        collapse = ", "
      )
    )
  )
}


# Convert condition to factor BEFORE constructing the design.
dge_fil$samples[[condition_column]] <- factor(
  dge_fil$samples[[condition_column]]
)


condition <- dge_fil$samples[[condition_column]]


message(
  "Available experimental groups: ",
  paste(
    levels(condition),
    collapse = ", "
  )
)



# ==========================================================
# 8. CHECK REQUESTED GROUPS
# ==========================================================

if (!(reference_group %in% levels(condition))) {

  stop(
    paste0(
      "Reference group '",
      reference_group,
      "' was not found in ",
      condition_column,
      "."
    )
  )
}


if (!(comparison_group %in% levels(condition))) {

  stop(
    paste0(
      "Comparison group '",
      comparison_group,
      "' was not found in ",
      condition_column,
      "."
    )
  )
}


if (reference_group == comparison_group) {

  stop(
    "reference_group and comparison_group must be different."
  )
}


# Check sample numbers per group.
group_sizes <- table(condition)

print(group_sizes)


if (group_sizes[reference_group] < 2 ||
    group_sizes[comparison_group] < 2) {

  warning(
    "One or both comparison groups contain fewer than two samples."
  )
}



# ==========================================================
# 9. CREATE DESIGN MATRIX
# ==========================================================

# Model contains one coefficient per experimental group.
design <- model.matrix(
  ~ 0 + condition
)


# Clean column names.
colnames(design) <- levels(condition)


message(
  "Design matrix:"
)

print(design)


message(
  "Design columns: ",
  paste(
    colnames(design),
    collapse = ", "
  )
)



# ==========================================================
# 10. DEFINE CONTRAST
# ==========================================================

# Define comparison explicitly:
#
#   comparison_group - reference_group
#
# Example:
#
#   ES - CTL
#
# Positive logFC therefore means higher expression in ES.

contrast_expression <- paste0(
  "`",
  comparison_group,
  "` - `",
  reference_group,
  "`"
)


contrast_matrix <- limma::makeContrasts(
  contrasts = contrast_expression,
  levels = design
)


message(
  "Testing contrast: ",
  comparison_group,
  " - ",
  reference_group
)


print(
  contrast_matrix
)



# ==========================================================
# 11. ESTIMATE DISPERSION
# ==========================================================

dge_fil <- estimateDisp(
  dge_fil,
  design
)



# ==========================================================
# 12. FIT NEGATIVE-BINOMIAL GLM
# ==========================================================

fit <- glmFit(
  dge_fil,
  design
)



# ==========================================================
# 13. LIKELIHOOD-RATIO TEST
# ==========================================================

lrt <- glmLRT(
  fit,
  contrast = contrast_matrix
)



# ==========================================================
# 14. EXTRACT COMPLETE DIFFERENTIAL-EXPRESSION RESULTS
# ==========================================================

# This table contains ALL genes tested by edgeR.
#
# No logFC or FDR threshold has been applied yet.

all_results <- topTags(
  lrt,
  n = Inf,
  adjust.method = p_adjust_method,
  sort.by = sort_results_by
)$table


# Add gene identifier as explicit column.
all_results$Gene <- rownames(
  all_results
)


# Move Gene to first column.
all_results <- all_results[
  c(
    "Gene",
    setdiff(
      colnames(all_results),
      "Gene"
    )
  )
]


message(
  "Differential-expression statistics calculated for ",
  nrow(all_results),
  " genes."
)



# ==========================================================
# 15. APPLY USER-DEFINED DEG THRESHOLDS
# ==========================================================

deg_results <- all_results[
  all_results$FDR < FDR_cutoff &
    abs(all_results$logFC) > logFC_cutoff,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]


message(
  "DEG definition:"
)

message(
  "  |log2FC| > ",
  logFC_cutoff
)

message(
  "  FDR < ",
  FDR_cutoff
)


message(
  "Number of DEGs: ",
  nrow(deg_results)
)



# ==========================================================
# 16. CLASSIFY UP- AND DOWNREGULATED GENES
# ==========================================================

# Direction is relative to:
#
#   comparison_group - reference_group
#
# Therefore:
#
# positive logFC =
#   higher in comparison_group
#
# negative logFC =
#   higher in reference_group


deg_up <- deg_results[
  deg_results$logFC > 0,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]


deg_down <- deg_results[
  deg_results$logFC < 0,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]


message(
  "Upregulated in ",
  comparison_group,
  ": ",
  nrow(deg_up)
)


message(
  "Downregulated in ",
  comparison_group,
  " / higher in ",
  reference_group,
  ": ",
  nrow(deg_down)
)



# ==========================================================
# 17. SAVE COMPLETE edgeR RESULTS
# ==========================================================

complete_results_file <- file.path(
  deg_list_dir,
  paste0(
    "all_tested_genes_",
    comparison_name,
    ".csv"
  )
)


write.csv(
  all_results,
  complete_results_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)



# ==========================================================
# 18. SAVE FILTERED DEG RESULTS
# ==========================================================

deg_results_file <- file.path(
  deg_list_dir,
  paste0(
    "DEG_",
    comparison_name,
    ".csv"
  )
)


write.csv(
  deg_results,
  deg_results_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)



# ==========================================================
# 19. SAVE UP- AND DOWNREGULATED DEG LISTS
# ==========================================================

write.csv(
  deg_up,
  file.path(
    deg_list_dir,
    paste0(
      "DEG_",
      comparison_name,
      "_up_in_",
      comparison_group,
      ".csv"
    )
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


write.csv(
  deg_down,
  file.path(
    deg_list_dir,
    paste0(
      "DEG_",
      comparison_name,
      "_down_in_",
      comparison_group,
      ".csv"
    )
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)



# ==========================================================
# 20. CREATE DEG SUMMARY
# ==========================================================

deg_summary <- data.frame(

  Comparison =
    paste(
      comparison_group,
      "vs",
      reference_group
    ),

  Tested_genes =
    nrow(all_results),

  log2FC_cutoff =
    logFC_cutoff,

  FDR_cutoff =
    FDR_cutoff,

  Total_DEGs =
    nrow(deg_results),

  Up_in_comparison_group =
    nrow(deg_up),

  Down_in_comparison_group =
    nrow(deg_down),

  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)


print(
  deg_summary
)


write.csv(
  deg_summary,
  file.path(
    deg_list_dir,
    paste0(
      "DEG_summary_",
      comparison_name,
      ".csv"
    )
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)



# ==========================================================
# 21. SAVE ANALYSIS SETTINGS
# ==========================================================

analysis_settings <- data.frame(

  Setting = c(
    "Condition column",
    "Reference group",
    "Comparison group",
    "Contrast",
    "log2FC cutoff",
    "FDR cutoff",
    "P-value adjustment",
    "Normalization"
  ),

  Value = c(
    condition_column,
    reference_group,
    comparison_group,
    paste0(
      comparison_group,
      " - ",
      reference_group
    ),
    logFC_cutoff,
    FDR_cutoff,
    p_adjust_method,
    "TMM normalization inherited from dge_fil.rds"
  )
)


write.csv(
  analysis_settings,
  file.path(
    deg_list_dir,
    paste0(
      "analysis_settings_",
      comparison_name,
      ".csv"
    )
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)



# ==========================================================
# 22. FINAL CHECKS
# ==========================================================

if (nrow(deg_results) == 0) {

  warning(
    paste0(
      "No genes passed the selected DEG thresholds:\n",
      "|log2FC| > ",
      logFC_cutoff,
      " and FDR < ",
      FDR_cutoff
    )
  )
}


if (anyNA(all_results$FDR)) {

  warning(
    "Some genes have missing FDR values."
  )
}


message(
  "Differential-expression analysis completed successfully."
)

message(
  "Complete results:\n",
  complete_results_file
)

message(
  "Filtered DEG results:\n",
  deg_results_file
)



# ==========================================================
# 23. SAVE SESSION INFORMATION
# ==========================================================

capture.output(
  sessionInfo(),
  file = file.path(
    deg_list_dir,
    paste0(
      "sessionInfo_02_DEG_",
      comparison_name,
      ".txt"
    )
  )
)
